description: Not equipment so much as a route: a stack of sand-filled kegs at one end of the room, a chalk line at the other, and the standing understanding that you carry them down and back until you can't. A knotted rope hangs off the joist halfway along for anyone who wants it worse. Somebody has painted lap markers on the floor in numbers that stop at forty, which is either a record or a joke about one.
name: conditioning circuit
